title: Radio service Scaleway GPU backend: remote command injection through station names, SSH host key not verified

criteria.given: an audio file name contains shell metacharacters such as $(, a backtick or a quote
criteria.then: the GPU backend refuses it and the remote transcription command cannot be changed by the name

criteria.given: the Scaleway GPU transcription backend source
criteria.then: no StrictHostKeyChecking=no option remains: the host key is learned once into a dedicated known_hosts file and every later connection strictly verifies it

criteria.given: the Scaleway GPU transcription backend source
criteria.then: the remote container image is pinned by digest, not a floating tag
